lines.en: Each step I take toward the hidden clearing feels a lot like walking on glass but, in a slightly poetic and only partially metaphorical way, I guess it kind of is.
lines.zh: 我每朝那片隐蔽的空地迈出一步，都觉得自己像走在碎玻璃上——不过以一种略带诗意、也只有一半是比喻的方式来说，我大概真的就是在走玻璃。

lines.en: In a less metaphorical way and more of a self-reflective one, it’s probably safe to say I’ve been doing that for quite some time with Noriko.
lines.zh: 而用不那么比喻、更像是自我剖析的方式说，我跟 Noriko 之间大概已经这样走了很久了。

lines.en: That every single road I’ve taken to her involved me cutting my soles while wishfully believing that the pressure of forward momentum would keep too much blood from escaping.
lines.zh: 通往她的每一条路，我都把自己的脚掌磨得血肉模糊，却一厢情愿地相信，只要一直往前冲的压力还在，就不会流掉太多的血。

lines.en: But now, all this time later, I’m infected in both of my legs and the pain has become so much to bear that amputation is really the only alternative.
lines.zh: 可如今，这么久过去，我两条腿都感染了，痛得已经难以承受，截肢真的是唯一的选择了。

lines.en: I’m getting too far off track, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 我又跑题了，对吧？

lines.en: Of course I am. That’s what I do.
lines.zh: 当然了。我一向如此。

lines.en: Run, but only until there’s something blocking your path. Then turn around and run in the opposite direction.
lines.zh: 跑，但只跑到有什么东西挡住去路为止。然后掉头，往相反的方向跑。
冲掉，重来。冲掉，重来。

lines.en: You can never get lost if you’re only alternating between forward and backward. That much is simple enough for anyone to understand.
lines.zh: 只要只在前和后之间来回切换，你就永远不会迷路。这道理简单到谁都懂。

lines.en: But what do you do when new obstacles appear during those swaps from right to left or west to east or whichever form of direction you choose to use?
lines.zh: 可当你在从右往左、从西往东、或者随便你用哪种方向表述的切换途中，冒出了新的障碍，你该怎么办？

lines.en: What do you do when your area to run is no greater than the length of your body?
lines.zh: 当你能跑的地方已经不比你的身长更宽时，你又该怎么办？

lines.en: I’m still too far off...yet the obstacles are closing in and the teeth of the allegory are decayed to the point where they can no longer lift me up by the skin of my neck and carry me off to safety.
lines.zh: 我依旧离题太远……可障碍正在逼近，而这条寓言的牙齿已经蛀坏，再也咬不住我后颈的皮、把我叼去安全的地方了。

lines.en: Do you know what that makes me?
lines.zh: 你知道这让我成了什么吗？
你当然知道。
你从头到尾都知道。

lines.en: You just hate admitting it because you want to chop my legs off.
lines.zh: 你只是不肯承认，因为你想把我的腿砍下来。

lines.en: I find the heart Noriko drew in the sand.
lines.zh: 我找到了 Noriko 画在沙子里的那颗心。

lines.en: It’s anatomically correct and eerily similar to her own.
lines.zh: 它在解剖学上完全正确，而且诡异地和她自己的那颗很像。

lines.en: I know what it looks like since it’s stuck to her sleeve.
lines.zh: 我知道它长什么样，因为它就别在她的袖子上。
: 我来了。

lines.en: : Already? But you haven’t even put it in. Am I really that beautiful?
lines.zh: : 这么快？可你还没插进来呢。我真有那么美吗？

lines.en: : Yup. Been saving that one up for thirty-one years, too. So thanks for the tension relief, but I’ll be on my way now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这句话我可是攒了三十一年才说出口。所以谢谢你能让我缓解紧张，不过我这就走了。

lines.en: : If that’s what I wanted...I’d probably have it by now, huh?
lines.zh: : 如果那就是我想要的……我大概早就得到了吧？
: Noriko？

lines.en: : Sorry, that came out a little hornier...more vague and...kind of bitchier than it sounded in my head.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，说出口之后……比在我脑子里想的要色情一点、更含糊一点，而且……更刻薄一点。

lines.en: : Just...vocally reflecting on how the biggest barrier to our current relationship is how picky I’ve been with the way things have to go.
lines.zh: : 只是……把心里想的说出来——我们之间现在最大的障碍，就是我对事情该按什么方式发展太挑剔了。

lines.en: : Basically...I could have chosen to be another Kirin. Someone who’s there to comfort you physically while neglecting the emotional aspect of the relationship between us...but I didn’t. Because I want more.
lines.zh: : 说白了……我本来可以选择当另一个 Kirin。一个只负责在肉体上安慰你、却忽略我们之间情感层面的人……但我没有。因为我想要更多。

lines.en: : It’s just that wanting more keeps us further away.
lines.zh: : 只是想要更多，反而让我们离得更远。

lines.en: : Who knows if it will take thirty-{i}two{/i} years for you to {i}actually{/i} relieve that tension? Or thirty-three? Or thirty-four? Why not forty?
lines.zh: : 谁知道要等到你三十{i}二{/i}岁才能{i}真正{/i}缓解那份紧张？还是三十三？三十四？干脆四十怎么样？

lines.en: : How long will it be before we finally become one? When will the comfort I feel stop being laced by caveats and uncertainties? And when will {i}you{/i} accept that it’s okay to feel loved?
lines.zh: : 我们究竟还要多久才能合二为一？我所感受到的慰藉，什么时候才能不再被附加条件和不确定感掺杂？而{i}你{/i}什么时候才会接受——被爱是一件没问题的事？

lines.en: : Anyway, that’ll suffice as a melancholic pre-bonfire monologue. Come sit. It’s not much of a Christmas date if you stand twenty feet behind me while I slowly toss all of my baggage at you.
lines.zh: : 总之，作为篝火前的忧郁独白，这些够了。过来坐吧。我在这儿慢慢把全部行李朝你扔过去，你却站在我身后二十英尺，那这趟圣诞约会也太不像话了。

lines.en: : Fine. But I’ve got another caveat or rule or whatever it is you want to call it.
lines.zh: : 行。不过我也有一个附加条件、规矩，随便你叫什么。

lines.en: : Hit me. I’m used to them by now.
lines.zh: : 说吧。我早就习惯了。

lines.en: : If you go on one more tangent about the distance between us and how you’re not sure how you’re going to conquer it, I am going to punch you in the face.
lines.zh: : 你要是再跑题讲一次我们之间的距离、讲你不知道该怎么跨越它，我就一拳打在你脸上。

lines.en: : What if I’m into that sort of thing?
lines.zh: : 万一我还挺喜欢这种事的呢？

lines.en: : Then feel free to go on your tangent and regress in the form of having violent, fireside sex with me while abandoning your need to groom me into husband material.
lines.zh: : 那你就尽管跑题，退行成和我来一场暴力的炉边性爱，顺便把你那套把我调教成丈夫材料的执念也扔了吧。

lines.en: : Hey now, I might be a lot of things, but I am certainly not a groomer. I’ve just staked my entire life on a future with you and-
lines.zh: : 喂喂，我也许是很多种人，但我绝对不是什么调教者。我只是把我整个人生都押在了一个有你的未来上，然后——
: 小心点。你正在接近挨揍的领域。
: 好。坐下。

lines.en: : But could you grab my guitar by that bench over there first? I’m going to fidget too much without something to hold onto and am too much of a coward to make the first move on you.
lines.zh: : 不过你能不能先去那边长椅旁把我的吉他拿过来？手里没点东西抓着我会坐立不安，而且我又是个怂包，不敢主动对你出手。

lines.en: : I am suddenly conflicted about whether I should get your guitar or just tackle you.
lines.zh: : 我突然有点纠结，到底该去拿你的吉他，还是直接把你扑倒。

lines.en: : No one would ever know if you did. And I’m barely clothed to begin with.
lines.zh: : 你要真扑上来，也没人会知道。何况我本来就几乎没穿什么。

lines.en: : And also very obedient when it comes to sex stuff. Probably. No experience, but I’m pretty sure that’s how it’s going to be if my fantasies are any indicator.
lines.zh: : 而且在性事上我很听话的。大概吧。虽然没经验，但如果我的幻想能说明什么的话，我敢肯定到时候就是那样。

lines.en: : You’re {i}trying{/i} to make this hard for me, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是{i}故意{/i}想让我难熬，对吧？
: 不是有意的。

lines.en: : But I’d be lying if I said making things more complicated than they have to be isn’t my thing, so...
lines.zh: : 不过要是我说“把事情搞得比必要的更复杂”不是我的专长，那我就是在撒谎，所以……

lines.en: : Grab my guitar...or grab me. Whichever one you want.
lines.zh: : 去拿我的吉他……或者来抓我。随便你选哪个。

lines.en: : I’ll be happy as long as I have something to hold onto.
lines.zh: : 只要手里有东西可以抓着，我就很开心了。

lines.en: : Look at you! Turning down the perfect opportunity to further our relationship!
lines.zh: : 看看你！居然放弃了推进我们关系的绝佳机会！

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better and you weren’t a six foot tall male, I might even think I’m looking at myself right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我不了解情况，而你又不是个六英尺高的男人，我大概会以为我此刻正看着我自己。

lines.en: : I think I understand how you want things to go by now. So I’m willing to suppress my immense sexual desire for you if it means making you happy.
lines.zh: : 我想我现在已经明白你想要事情怎么发展了。所以只要能让你开心，我愿意压抑对你那汹涌的性欲。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei. I will also consider suppressing my immense sexual desire for you so that we can {i}both{/i} be happy.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。我也会考虑压抑我对你的汹涌性欲，好让我们{i}两个{/i}都能幸福。

lines.en: : Unless that burden becomes too much to bear. In that case, please take care of me and do not hesitate to leave your hand prints all over my body. Like, for real. I want bruises.
lines.zh: : 除非那份负担沉重到无法承受。那样的话，请好好照顾我，别犹豫，把你手印留在我全身。说真的，我要淤青。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind, but I’m not really sure about the bruising thing when you’re in regular contact with both your family and my ex-girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我记下了，不过在你和家人还有我前女友都有日常接触的情况下，我真不太确定留淤青这事合不合适。

lines.en: : Your ex-girlfriend is {i}also{/i} my family, you know. And currently very pissed off that you are with {i}me{/i} instead of her.
lines.zh: : 你前女友{i}也算{/i}我的家人啊。而且她现在正因为你和{i}我{/i}在一起、而不是和她在一起，气得要命。
: 她知道了？

lines.en: : Well, not {i}directly.{/i} I didn’t tell her we made plans or anything. She just knows that we’re both in the same place at the same time and that you never responded to her date request.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不算{i}直接{/i}知道。我没跟她说我们约好了之类的。她只知道我们俩在同一时间出现在同一个地方，而你一直没回她的约会申请。

lines.en: : But hey, she’s pissed off at {i}me{/i} as well since I also bailed on her.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，她也在生{i}我{/i}的气，因为我也放了她鸽子。

lines.en: : If I knew I’d be dating both of you on Christmas and wasn’t subject to sudden timeskips, that would have changed everything and I probably wouldn’t even be here right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我知道圣诞节会同时跟你们两个约会，又不会遭遇突如其来的时间跳跃，那一切都会不一样，我大概现在根本不会在这儿。

lines.en: : I think Nee-chan and I are a little too competitive to both date you at the same time. Also, what?
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Nee-chan 和我都太好胜了，没法同时跟你交往。还有，你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : Long story. Not believable. But what sort of plans did you have with Niki that you wound up abandoning for my sake?
lines.zh: : 说来话长。而且不可信。不过你为了我而放弃的、跟 Niki 之间原本有什么安排？

lines.en: : I agreed to help her with her Christmas concert before I knew we were doing our trip {i}here{/i}.
lines.zh: : 在知道我们要来{i}这儿{/i}旅行之前，我答应过帮她做圣诞演唱会。

lines.en: : Originally figured I could just bounce once the show ended and meet up with everybody afterward. Kinda like I did last year, but with fewer mementos of the past and less martyrdom.
lines.zh: : 本来想着演出一结束就溜走，之后再跟大家碰头。跟去年差不多，只是少了些过去的纪念品，也少了些殉道的味道。

lines.en: : Just hope she was able to find a replacement in time since I was going to do backup for a few of her songs.
lines.zh: : 只希望她来得及找人替补，因为我本来要在她几首歌里做伴唱的。

lines.en: : You...were going to be on stage with Niki?
lines.zh: : 你……本来要和 Niki 一起上台？

lines.en: : Mhm. What’s wrong? Upset you didn’t get to see me in a cute idol costume?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。怎么了？没看到我穿可爱的偶像服装，很遗憾？

lines.en: : I just didn’t really think music like that was your style.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到那种音乐是你的风格。

lines.en: : I’ve been up there with Niki a few times. The idol industry might be antithetical to my personal values as a musician and activist, but she’s my sister and I like money. So yeah, I’d do it.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Niki 上台过几次。偶像产业也许跟我作为音乐人和活动家的个人价值观相悖，但她是我姐姐，而且我喜欢钱。所以是啊，我会去做。

lines.en: : I learned something about you today.
lines.zh: : 今天我又了解了一件事。

lines.en: : Is it that I’m a sellout?
lines.zh: : 我是个出卖灵魂的人？

lines.en: : No. It’s that prototype Noriko is actually pretty cool.
lines.zh: : 不是。是“原型 Noriko”其实还挺酷的。
: 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Ignoring the familial aspect of that, compromising on your morals for a higher chance at self-progress is the mark of a smart person.
lines.zh: : 嗯。撇开亲情那层不谈，为了让自我前进的机会更大而在道德上妥协，是聪明人的标志。

lines.en: : Are you only saying that because you want me to compromise on more personal beliefs and fuck your brains out right now?
lines.zh: : 你说这话，只是因为想让我在更多个人信念上妥协，然后现在就把你操到脑子空掉吧？

lines.en: : My suppression tactics are obviously not perfect. I know.
lines.zh: : 我的压抑战术显然还不够完美。我知道。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I did not have complete faith in myself tonight either.
lines.zh: : 要是能让你好受点的话，今晚我对自己也没抱十足的信心。

lines.en: : This is evidenced by the pack of condoms that I brought along even though Kirin laughed in my face for it before informing me that you would never wear one in a million years.
lines.zh: : 证据就是我还带了一盒安全套——尽管 Kirin 当着我的面嘲笑我，说你一百万年都不可能戴那个。

lines.en: : Say what you want about her morals, but she knows me well.
lines.zh: : 她的道德观你随便怎么评价，但她确实很了解我。

lines.en: : That’s cool. I’ll just make balloons out of them if I get bored or something.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我要是闲得慌，就拿它们吹气球什么的。

lines.en: : You’ve got a guitar too, you know. Aren’t those supposed to help with boredom?
lines.zh: : 你不是还有把吉他吗？那东西不是应该能解闷吗？
: 除了别的用处之外，是的。

lines.en: : Like trying to impress the people you love in front of dozens of {i}other{/i} people who are suddenly invited into the same stream of emotion and general consciousness?
lines.zh: : 比如在几十个突然被请进同一股情感与共同意识之流的人面前，去打动你爱的人？
: 还有耍帅，对。

lines.en: : There’s a lot you can do with a guitar. Or any instrument. Or just...art in general, really.
lines.zh: : 一把吉他能做的事可多了。任何乐器都是。或者干脆说……艺术本身，真的。

lines.en: : Do you know why I started playing in the first place, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你知道我最初为什么开始玩音乐吗？

lines.en: : Probably to win my heart or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是为了赢走我的心之类的吧。

lines.en: : Well, yes. There is that. But I never would have taken to it in the first place if I wasn’t trying to follow in your footsteps.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也是一部分。但如果我不是想追随你的脚步，我根本就不会走上这条路。

lines.en: : I have never touched a guitar in my life. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没碰过吉他。大概吧。

lines.en: : No...but I used to love reading your poetry.
lines.zh: : 是没碰过……但我以前很爱读你写的诗。

lines.en: : You’re not very outwardly emotional, so the things you wrote were like little windows into your heart.
lines.zh: : 你不太把情绪写在脸上，所以你写下的东西，就像一扇扇通向你内心的小窗。

lines.en: : And I thought that, if one day, I could make enough windows to my heart as well, you’d finally see just how much space there is inside of me for you.
lines.zh: : 而我想，如果有一天我也能为我的心开出足够多的窗，你终会看见我里面为你留了多少空间。
: 憋回去，Noriko。

lines.en: : Not vaginal space. Emotional space. I don’t think I have much to offer in terms of the former. But hey, if what I hear is true, that’ll just make it better for you.
lines.zh: : 不是阴道里的空间。是情感空间。前者我大概没什么可给的。不过嘿，如果传闻属实，那对你来说反而更好。
: Noriko——

lines.en: : Can I finish playing my song, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，能让我把歌唱完吗？

lines.en: : Nobody else is here...so there’s no need to feel self-conscious or embarrassed or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 这儿没有别人……所以你不必觉得不自在或者难为情什么的。

lines.en: : You can hurt in front of me if you want to. You can {i}cry{/i} if you want to. You can do anything.
lines.zh: : 你想在我面前痛苦也行。想{i}哭{/i}也行。做什么都行。

lines.en: : I’m sure the atmosphere was a major factor in your {i}previous{/i} reaction, but...that came out of nowhere. And you’ll know what’s coming this time.
lines.zh: : 我猜氛围是你{i}上次{/i}那种反应的重要因素，不过……那次来得太突然了。而这回你提前知道会发生什么。

lines.en: : I just want to reach you the same way you reached me when I was a little girl.
lines.zh: : 我只是想触达你，就像我还是个小女孩时你触达我那样。

lines.en: : I want to show you how much space there is.
lines.zh: : 我想让你看看，那里有多大的空间。
: 不管了，开始吧。
: 闭上眼睛。
: 照做就是了。
: {i}圣诞快乐。{/i}
: 嗯嗯………嗯呜~
: 嗯唔！……嗯嗯唔！
: 嗯唔唔！………唔呣………嗯嗯唔唔！~
: 真可爱……
: 她让你想起{i}我{/i}……

lines.en: : There are plenty of {i}artistic{/i} girls out there, you know?
lines.zh: : 有{i}艺术气质{/i}的女孩多的是，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Ones who are good at everything...universally loved...who can captivate a room by simply being “special.”
lines.zh: : 什么都擅长的……被所有人喜欢的……光是“特别”就能让全场为之倾倒的那种。
: {b}全是谎言。{/b}
: {i}你{/i}并不“特别”。
: {i}没有谁{/i}是“特别”的。

lines.en: : We’re all little bugs. Eating and sleeping and shitting and fucking...day in and day out...but why? Because we’re {i}supposed{/i} to do those things?
lines.zh: : 我们都只是小虫子。吃、睡、拉、操……日复一日……可为什么呢？因为我们{i}本该{/i}做这些事？

lines.en: : Of course not...It’s because we’re meant to survive. The purpose of {i}everything{/i} is to survive.
lines.zh: : 当然不是……那是因为我们生来就要活下去。{i}一切{/i}的意义就是活下去。

lines.en: : Bugs can catch parasites too, you know? They’re dangerous to {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 虫子也是会招寄生虫的，你知道吗？它们对{i}什么都{/i}危险。

lines.en: : {b}Bite off her tongue{/b}...{s}or pretend it's my own.{/s}
lines.zh: : {b}咬断她的舌头{/b}……{s}或者假装那是我的舌头。{/s}
: 中间的任何状态都是错的。
: 我的话即是律法
: {size=+40}{b}AKIRA???????{/b}{/size}
: 嗯唔唔！嗯唔！嗯………唔唔！~
